rows.text: A portal item dated 18 March 2003 reports that the governor of Roraima, Flamarion Portela, signed his PT membership form that afternoon in Brasília at a ceremony 'contou com a presença do presidente do PT, José Genoino', and quotes 'O presidente nacional do PT' calling the affiliation a historic moment.
